name: Today, I'll Be The Hero
storyline:
️️️

Becoming the hero isn't a decision you made just today... right?

You know being the hero isn't only about who gets to save the princess, but, well, isn't it?

So here's how this is going to go.

You're going to save THE PRINCESS! You're going to be THE HERO!

You are going to forge the legacy you've always dreamed of!

With your friends by your side, there is nothing, nothing, nothing you can't do.

That's right! Today, you'll be THE HERO!
summary:
You're the hero, and you're going to save the princess with your merry little crew.

This is what you wanted.

What else is there to say?
